LanguageData.CC_ScenStart_AsGroup: New people as a new game's group
LanguageData.CC_ScenStart_AsScenarioTip: Any loaded scenario can shape the new colony alone: its people, what shapes them, its kit, its arrival, its animals and Rimfolk's own parts. Click to choose one, or to change it.
LanguageData.CC_ScenStart_Brief: Carried for the new colony alone: {LIST}.
LanguageData.CC_ScenStart_BriefWhole_Hooks: what shapes people (the deeper game hooks are off)
LanguageData.CC_ScenStart_BriefWhole_Other: the other parts its list names
LanguageData.CC_ScenStart_KitPrice: With the old colony kept, their passage covers its kit too: about {SILVER} silver's worth more.
LanguageData.CC_ScenStart_ListLine: What each scenario brings to the new colony alone. A whole new scenario, on its own page, is what a new game is for.
LanguageData.CC_ScenStart_From_0: The game's, its expansions', Rimfolk's and other mods' scenarios
LanguageData.CC_ScenStart_Carried: Carried, for the new colony alone
LanguageData.CC_ScenStart_NewGame: The newcomers join the colony's own people in the same world: its research, its storyteller, the world's conditions and every other people stay as they are. For a whole new scenario on its own page, start a new game.
LanguageData.CC_ScenStart_Arrive_Standing: They walk in from the edge of the land, their kit with them.
LanguageData.CC_ScenStart_Arrive_Pods: They come down in drop pods, a pod each and the kit shared between them: near the middle of a new colony's land, or near the colony's people when some go there first.
LanguageData.CC_ScenStart_Arrive_Gravship: They come in their gravship, set down near the middle of the land with their kit on its shelves.
LanguageData.CC_ScenStart_NoGravship: The gravship comes only with the old colony left behind and nobody of the colony there before them, so they walk in instead.
LanguageData.CC_ScenStart_BeholdenCold: The grant is that colony's own tie, without the warm start: the people's goodwill stays the whole colony's.
LanguageData.CC_ScenStart_Whole_Faction: Its own people ({WHAT}): the newcomers join the colony's people as it is.
LanguageData.CC_ScenStart_Whole_Research: Starting research ({WHAT}): what the colony knows is the whole game's, and stays as it is.
LanguageData.CC_ScenStart_Whole_Rules: Rules for every map ({WHAT}): they would change the whole game.
LanguageData.CC_ScenStart_Whole_Map: Its own kind of map ({WHAT}): the new colony's map is made the game's way for the place you picked.
LanguageData.CC_ScenStart_Whole_Conditions: World conditions ({WHAT}): they would change the whole world.
LanguageData.CC_ScenStart_Whole_IncidentsOff: Incidents switched off ({WHAT}): the storyteller stays the whole game's.
LanguageData.CC_ScenStart_Whole_Events: The whole game's events ({WHAT}): they belong to a new game.
LanguageData.CC_ScenStart_Whole_Opening: The opening words: they belong to a new game.
LanguageData.CC_ScenStart_Whole_Hooks: What shapes starting people ({WHAT}): it needs Rimfolk's deeper game hooks, which are off.
LanguageData.CC_ScenStart_Unknown: {LABEL}: another mod's part, which Rimfolk doesn't know, so it isn't carried.
LanguageData.CC_ScenStart_PeopleUnknown: Their people part is another mod's: the newcomers come as a new game's group, one to six of them.
LanguageData.CC_ScenStart_Never_Families: Two families who never got on: a feud along family lines never comes, since the colony is the family.
LanguageData.CC_ScenStart_WindowLine: A start as {SCENARIO} has it: its people, its count and what shapes them.
LanguageData.CC_ScenStart_Missing: {SCENARIO} isn't loaded any more, so the newcomers come as a new game's group.
LanguageData.CC_ScenStart_LeaveTip: Leave them behind: the first of those left behind comes instead.
LanguageData.CC_ScenStart_TakeTip: Take them: they come in place of the one in view, or of the last of those coming.
LanguageData.CC_ScenStart_FoundText: {NAMES} have come to found {PLACE}, answering {CALL} from {MOTHER}: a start as {SCENARIO} has it.
LanguageData.CC_ScenStart_ComeText: {NAMES} have come to {PLACE}, answering {CALL}: a start as {SCENARIO} has it.
LanguageData.CC_ScenStart_Came_Standing: They walked in from the edge of the land with their kit.
LanguageData.CC_ScenStart_Came_Pods: They come down in drop pods, with their kit shared between the pods.
LanguageData.CC_ScenStart_Came_Gravship: Their gravship stands near the middle of the land, their kit on its shelves.
LanguageData.CC_ScenStart_NoGravshipLetter: The gravship start couldn't be given here, so they walked in.
LanguageData.CC_ScenStart_History: {NAMES} came to {PLACE} as newcomers, a start as {SCENARIO} has it.
LanguageData.CC_ScenStart_SetupIntro: {PLACE} didn't start with a clean slate: its newcomers came as {SCENARIO} has them.
